instructions: Add only field-verified or OpenStreetMap-sourced walking nodes, path geometries, and location access mappings. Each node has id, latitude, and longitude. Each edge has from, to, and coordinates: an ordered array of [latitude, longitude] points that traces the real walkable segment from the from node to the to node. location_access maps a saved campus location id (for example location_12) to a pathway node id at its verified entrance. No route is available until this graph is populated.
